name: ara-core
description: ARA, the Ant-Colony-Based Routing Algorithm (Güneş, Sorges & Bouazizi, 2002), for MANETs: a simulator-agnostic C++ core on swarm-core (FANT/BANT route discovery, evaporating pheromone trails, data reinforcement, duplicate errors and route-failure backtracking, switchable 2003 variants) and an ns-3 contrib module, with a paper-fidelity sheet.
